feature: Endpoint reject officer kedua POST /v1/furnish/officer/reject (kirim email custom ke owner lalu set status Rejected; resend notice ke portal masih TODO)
note: Controller menyebut 'OCMS41.24-41.33' tetapi ocmsadminui tidak memanggilnya (grep furnish/officer di ocmsadminui/src: 0 hasil); UI memakai manual-review/reject. Email dikirim sebelum status diubah, tanpa jadwal, dan resendNoticeToPortal hanya TODO yang selalu return true (FurnishRejectionServiceImpl.java:153-158). Bukan dasar klaim story yang ditrace.
note_en: The controller cites 'OCMS41.24-41.33' but ocmsadminui does not call it (grep furnish/officer in ocmsadminui/src: 0 hits); the UI uses manual-review/reject. The email is sent before the status is changed, without a schedule, and resendNoticeToPortal is only a TODO that always returns true (FurnishRejectionServiceImpl.java:153-158). Not a basis for claiming the traced stories.
